entities.name: Choe Hyo-sim
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Choe Hyo-sim is a North Korean weightlifter. She competed at the 2016 Summer Olympics in Rio de Janeiro, and won a silver medal in the women's 63 kg. She won the silver medal at the 2013 Summer Universiade.
